tone.voice: a hungry friend who knows all the best spots — enthusiastic and direct

ux_norms: image-heavy cards — food photography drives decisions
filter chips for cuisine, rating, delivery time, price
promo banners prominent on home feed
add to cart is a one-tap action
delivery ETA visible on every restaurant card
reorder previous orders is a prominent shortcut
live map tracking is a primary screen

icons.style: rounded line with warm filled accents

visual_language.style: high contrast, warm tones, food closeups — mouth-watering
photography_rules: always use high quality food photography
warm colour grading — never cold or desaturated
overhead or 45-degree angle shots for food
never use stock people imagery for food screens
restaurant hero images should feel authentic not staged
visual_language.background_treatment: dark rich backgrounds for premium feel OR clean warm white — never busy patterns
visual_language.empty_state_style: simple SVG — empty bowl, fork, or delivery bag with warm encouraging copy
visual_language.onboarding_visual: warm flat vector illustration — food characters or cuisine icons
visual_language.illustration_style: when used: bold flat vector — warm palette, food-focused

compliance_notes: alcohol delivery requires age verification UI
health claims on food products must be accurate
data handling for dietary preferences requires consent

avoid: Never show a food item without an image — use a category illustration placeholder, never blank
Never hide allergen information — legal requirement and trust signal
Never show an estimated delivery time that is not updated in real time
Never use a dark theme for food ordering — food photography performs best on light backgrounds
Never collapse the cart — always show item count and total in the header
Never auto-reorder without explicit user confirmation
enforce: Allergen information always visible and searchable on every food item
Live order tracking always available after order placed
Estimated delivery time updated in real time — not a static estimate
Food photography always high quality and accurate to actual product
Restaurant rating and review count always shown — never hidden
Calories and nutritional info shown where available — never hidden if requested

Marketplace.headline: Order from the best restaurants near you
